notes.title: Screenshake Update and Secret Level(?)
notes.notes:
Screenshake update and [strike]secret level[/strike]


Hey! Marcos here!

On this update, I'm adding an option on the main menu to disable/enable screenshake.

In several parts of the game, the screen shakes slightly giving a more impactful effect, like when you teleport, step on an interactive object or when Clawbert's Dad strikes with his claw.

Some people find this effect uncomfortable, so I'm adding an option to disable it! Just go to the game's Main Menu, then options, then select Toggle Screenshake.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769284/5c125f64ba5db0daa8818281f151de918e633fbe.png

One other thing on this update is that the game now has a secret level. That's all I'm gonna say. It's very, very well hidden.

Obviously there won't be any achievements tied to this secret level. It is so well hidden that I expect it will take a long time for even a single person to find it.

I added this kind of as a joke, so if I were you, I wouldn't get too hung up on this. Just look for it if you are a die hard fan of hidden things in games.

That's all for today, thank you for playing Dimensional Animals!

notes.title: 🔑 The Key Update now available!
notes.notes:
Key Markers on the Map!

Hey! Marcos here bringing another update for Dimensional Animals!

The latest update brings you a new map marker, for keys!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769284/92d0053ac12b3edd0d84c580391c568451b98b96.png

Do you see it?

In every spot where there's an unused key, there will be a marker. This is specially useful for two situations:

1 - When you die, every key that you had in you returns to where it was originally. Previously, there wasn't a marker there to help you, so you had to rely on memory to find the key again. Now, though, there will be a marker reminding you where it is!

2 - When you change locations through a portal, again, every key that was on you returns to its origin. The marker will be very helpful here as well!

Gone are the days of being stuck on a locked door which you don't know where a key is at.

Please note two additional IMPORTANT info about the key markers:

1 - When you get close to a key, the marker will be added automatically, which means the map won't already be full of markers. You have to find the keys yourself, just like the little yellow markers for collectible diamonds and orbs!

2 - Unfortunately, this update will only work for newly found keys. Which means that if you run the game in a slot that's already in progress, the keys that have already been found but not used won't have markers for them. You have to get close to them again to fill the marker.

Hopefully the key marker will make experiencing Dimensional Animals even more fun!

If you have any questions, just comment below.

Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

Bye bye

notes.title: June 22nd Update!
notes.notes:
Hey, guys! Marcos here.

Today I bring a bug fix and a new addition to the game's exploration!

- Fixed a bug found with the yellow sprite that appears on the map, showing you where there's an item. In any room with 2 or more upgrades, if you collected some of them but not all and then died, upon returning to the room to collect the rest would cause the yellow sprite to not disappear. It's fixed now!

- And added a new map connection in Nightmare Land that allows you to climb the big falling area just before the boss fight. Once the boss is defeated, all these charge drones will be activated, allowing you to climb back upwards by using the frog skill!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769284/16413e08f7139cf972960cd40baa0cf7355b8fc1.png

Previously there were no charge drones, so the only way to go back up there was through severe backtracking. It was pretty inconvenient, but it's now fixed!

If you don't know which area I'm talking about, don't worry about it, this climb is very specific so it probably wasn't an inconvenient for you. Just know that there is one more way to navigate around this area, so it's pretty cool.

Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

notes.title: Obscure Bug Fixes :O
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Marcos here with another patch for DImensional Animals.

Every game has very obscure bugs, some that are difficult to execute. These ones are very difficult to fix as well, since I only TODAY managed to replicate them here to start investigating where the issue might be hahaha

So let's see the fixes:


 When pressing TAB or SELECT to open the minimap, if you remained holding a direction on the d-pad, analog stick or keyboard, the minimap would keep moving to the chosen direction while the menu was opening. This didn't cause any issues to the game, but was not right visually, so it's fixed now
 During a boss fight, if you decided to open your map on the menu and move it around, once the boss was defeated and your minimap restored back on the screen it would be in the wrong position. Opening your map menu and closing it would restore it to the correct position, so this is more of a visual fix
 After defeating rematch boss fights, if you sped up the defeat animation, the zoom in would stay in the game! You'd have to return to the main menu to fix the zoom. It's fixed now!


But that's not all! 

There's also a very cool addition to PLUS mode! The map will only show the rooms you've visited!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769284/70a3f2ebecc50e2bb0566749ffed5ed352d59946.png

Yeah, plus mode is going to be harder now.

Some people asked me to make the map like this in normal mode as well. But Dimensional Animals is designed to be a game for everyone. If you want to have a breezy experience, just play through the game normally. But if you want to aim for the 100% and also play the PLUS mode, you're going to be challenged! This way you can play how you want, and aim for the amount of challenge you want.

Just to make it clear, the normal mode will remain with the map looking like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769284/f9debf6ca7183e2df66cf0c37cce4de716502fed.png

The rooms that you've visited are highlighted, but the rooms you haven't will still be showing on the map.

This way it's easier to decide where to go next!

You won't have this luxury anymore on PLUS mode, though. You'll have to rely on memory or navigation skills to play this more challenging mode.

Hope you like this change!

Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

notes.title: UPDATE! Upwards Teleport Fix + Other fixes
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Bringing you another patch for Dimensional Animals.

This one is aimed at fixing these issues:


 In certain framerates, when using the upwards teleport you'd freeze in mid-air. Sliding through the air like life has no problems. It is now fixed and also has a new effect, the game will enter slow motion for a fraction of a second to give you more time to think on your next aerial move.
 Sometimes when grabbing a diamond or orb, the minimap symbol wouldn't disappear. With the current update it shouldn't happen anymore!
 Sometimes the cursor on the main menu or pause menu would go CRAZY when using a gamepad's analog stick. It is now fixed!


Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

notes.title: Second Boss Rework Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Marcos here bringing another update to Dimensional Animals.

This is a big one, one that I feel we can call a major update, since it brings a rework to a boss in the game!

Don't worry, he still has the same attacks, but they feel a little better to play against.

So let's see what has been reworked on Cespuglio Bolshoi, the boss fight in Cobalt Forest:

1 - Prank Attack

The attack where the screen turns black, the boss disappears, you change position and minions are spawned.

My intention with this attack was always for it to feel like a prank. Since the boss shares similarities with the bush enemies from this level, I wanted one attack to have the same feel as the bushes.

Some people didn't like the black screen transition, as it felt too abrupt and too untied to the boss. So I changed the transition for it to look more like he is causing it.

It turned out like this: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769284/3d2d28a0a1e0573097977d550f249de4983eb034.gif

2 - Biting Attack

Just a small fix on this one. This attack LOOKS like you can teleport across the boss, but you actually couldn't because his hitbox was way too big horizontally.

I always had the intention of making this attack avoidable only by the duck's double jump. But seeing as the animation makes it look like you can teleport across him, I decided to allow it, by decreasing the hitbox.

It will also make it a little easier to double jump above him! Which I think is still the easiest way to avoid the attack.

This is how it looks right now: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769284/8dd1503b8a14aa0c0d5679da55003d5669441d85.gif

That's all for the boss's rework!

Now for another fix released on this patch:

Minimap Fix

Every time you are on the same screen as a collectable, a yellow sprite will appear on your minimap location. 

I forgot to add some of them, though!

For this reason, if you would collect something in a room that didn't have the yellow sprite in it, it would make another yellow sprite disappear! This could create a very problematic situation where you'd have the whole map explored while still missing a collectable, but without being able to see a yellow sprite pointing towards this missing collectable, making you run around the map trying to find it.

This is now fixed! 

And that's it for this update! Hope you enjoy the changes.

Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

notes.notes:

Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

notes.title: We were New and Trending! + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We were on New and Trending!

Hello, guys! Marcos here from Dimensional Animals development team.

Dimensional Animals got into the New and Trending tab in Brazil!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769284/ff9ee64dc6208fe4d0d3ed31762e1002fea25f53.png

It's not there anymore (I think), but even if it only lasted a few hours, it was amazing seeing the game on the store's front page.

Thanks for being a part of it and helping it happen!

Bug Fixes

It's literally impossible to not have bugs on a game's release. So there you go, a batch of bug fixes just released on the last patch:


 Fixed some tiles that were misplaced

 Fixed a bug where, on Gamepad, you could go through doors by looking to the opposite side of the door, pressing the teleport button and very quickly switching the direction you're looking

 In the pause menu in Portuguese, changed "Trocar Trajes" to "Trocar Cores"

 Fixed a bug where, if you fought Joana's rematch before her regular fight, she would jump out of the screen during the hair dryer attack

 Made a little change in World 2 near the orb that's close to a horizontal moving platform. Added a little edge to make it easier to get to the wall on the right without using the Duck

 Fixed a bug where you could enter animal fusing cutscenes spinning with the Duck and it would leave you bugged flying and lock the game, forcing you to restart

 Fixed a bug where, sometimes, the bubble enemy on World 3 would get stuck on walls while walking

 Fixed a bug where the zoom in wouldn't get reset after fighting rematch bosses

 Fixed an issue where you could accidentally open very important doors in World 2. So I changed these doors to 3 keys instead of 1

 Added a new door to World 3 to prevent you from reaching the Frog before fighting the boss


That's it for today. If you find more bugs or any other stuff to fix, please let me know

Thanks!!
